name: n8
description: N8 block-size study cells (ideas/queue/N8_block_size_for_round_based_primitives.md): block scope at 64, 128, 256 and 512 threads. B2 packed rounds at N 1024 to 4096 (k 4 to 64), the two-level list at N 8192 to 32768 (k 4 to 64), radix at N 16384 and 32768 (k 16 to 1024). Both key types, both unsorted requirements, random input, both regimes. Every batch filters threads, N and k with the run.py options, k_by_n picks the k per N.
